title: GitHub workflow: on a tag, build, sign, attest, attach to a draft release

history.what: review: feed per tag, universal toolchain

before.body: Rollback: delete the draft release and the rc tag.

done_when: a pushed rc tag produces a draft release with Tether.zip and a build attestation, and the workflow has no update-key secret
command: manual: push tag v6.1.0-rc1; gh release view v6.1.0-rc1 lists Tether.zip; gh attestation verify passes
body: Rollback: delete the draft release and the rc tag. A tag with -rc builds with --feed test, any other v tag with --feed prod. The runner builds --arch arm64 --arch x86_64 (D-2) on a macos runner with Xcode's Swift.
